Question 15
?

Find the equation of the level surface for the function f(x,y,z)=z−x2+y2xy that passes through the point P(1,1,2).

a
z=(x+y)2
b
z=x2+2xy−y2
c
z=x2−2xy−y2
d
z=y2+2xy−x2
e
z=(x−y)2
